summary: The page displays noticeable RTL rendering defects, including punctuation inversion on English copy and inconsistent text alignment within trace items.

issues.title: Inconsistent Row Alignment
issues.description: Trace rows show mixed horizontal alignments within the same container.
issues.evidence: The GET endpoint row is left-aligned while other tool rows are right-aligned.
issues.suggestion: Standardize text direction and alignment for all trace rows.

issues.title: Punctuation Misplacement in RTL
issues.description: English strings in an RTL context place trailing punctuation at line starts.
issues.evidence: Leading periods on '.nothing runs silently' and '?Forgot password'.
issues.suggestion: Apply dir="ltr" to English text nodes or containers.
